title: Cambom Lemon Zester Grater Three-piece Suit - Heavy Duty Kitchen Tool for Parmesan Cheese, Ginger, Garlic, Nutmeg, Chocolate, Vegetables，Fruits，Stainless Steel Grater Dishwasher Safe Black
description:
About this item
Cheese Grater Combination Set: Grater with fine, Coarse and Extra coarse holes and a cleaning brush. Each one comes with a protective shell. Super cost performance portfolio
Meet Your Different Needs: The multi-functional grater helps you complete the pre-cooking preparation for pillow Parmesan, lemon, ginger, garlic, nutmeg, chocolate, cinnamon, vegetables and citrus fruits
Superior Process: Lemon Zester is made of 304 stainless steel ；The blade is uniform, sharp, and does not clog easily. The comfortable TPR handle is a good size and feels good to hold
Safe Design：At the bottom of the planer, there are anti-skid bars, which make the operation more stable. Lifetime rust free, dishwasher safe
Convenient Storage: The Fine blade is 11.8×1.45 in. Coarse and Extra Coarse are 11.4×2.4 in. Exquisite proportions, very comfortable to operate. There are mounting holes at the top for easy hanging
